outcome: maternal and neonatal morbidity and mortality
cohort: The study included 160 pregnant women between 20 and 40 weeks' gestation, equally divided into preeclampsia and normotensive control groups.
finding: Serum PlGF levels were significantly lower in preeclamptic women compared to controls and were significantly associated with increased disease severity and adverse fetomaternal outcomes.
mod_finding: Preeclampsia cases, which showed reduced PlGF levels, were associated with higher rates of caesarean delivery.
